title: Te Wairua Tuatahi ki te Tū
intro: I mua noa atu i te haerenga mai o tētahi karere ki te whenua, i mua i te whakakitenga mai o tētahi karaipiture, i puta mai tētahi mea kāore i rite ki tētahi atu. I hangaia tēnei wairua e ngā ringa atua, i hoatu he wāhi ataahua kāore e rite, ā, i whakamatautauria i roto i tētahi ara e rangona ana i roto i te hītori katoa o te tangata. Ko te mea i whai ake ko tētahi kōrero mō te ngoikore, te ripeneta pono, me tētahi aituā ka huri i te huarahi o te hanganga ake ake. Ka taea e koe te matapae ko wai tēnei?
clues: I hangaia ahau e ngā ringa o te Atua Aroha rawa mai i te puehu o te whenua
I homai ki ahau he kāinga ataahua, kāore e taea te whakataurite, te wāhi kāore e taea e te hiakai, e te ngenge rānei te pā mai ki ahau.
I whakahaua ahau kia kaua rawa e whakatata ki tētahi rākau, nā te mea i rāhuitia
I mamingatia māua ko taku hoa, ā, ka whakatata māua ki te rākau tapu, i runga i te ture a tō tātou Ariki.
I tahuri mātou ki tō mātou Ariki me te ripeneta pono, ā, i murua ō mātou hara
Nō tātou te tangata katoa i ahu mai; ko au te tuatahi ki te hikoi i runga i tēnei whenua

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te whakamatautauranga a te rākau tapu
Te hanga i te Āraka nui
Te patunga tapu a te tama aroha
Te maka ki roto i te ahi nui
trial.answer: Te whakamatautauranga a te rākau tapu

outcome.label: Hua
options: I tukuna iho ki te whenua hei kaitiaki tuatahi mō te tangata
I toremi a Parao rātou ko tana ope taua ki te moana
I whakangaromia te hunga kino e te waipuke nui
I mātao te ahi, ā, i marino
I whakawhiwhia ki te mana whakahaere i te kingitanga o Ihipa
outcome.answer: I tukuna iho ki te whenua hei kaitiaki tuatahi mō te tangata

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
